<thought>The spectrum shows a classic carbon isotopic envelope with peaks spaced ~1.003 Da and intensities decreasing roughly according to the binomial distribution for many carbons. No characteristic Cl (3:1 M+2), Br (1:1 M+2), or S (≈4 % M+2) patterns are present, and other elements have isotopic contributions too small to be seen. Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotope distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
